nodes.label: server_v2.py
nodes.description: Auth-authoritative HTTP server. Harness + Session + Sandbox + Cowrie bridge. Default mode. Standalone disabled.

nodes.label: server.py
nodes.description: Legacy HTTP server. Chrollo/Don/Hisoka/Jev standalone. Hisoka deceive/lure return 410.

nodes.label: Harness
nodes.description: Stateless orchestration loop. Chrollo→Don→Hisoka pipeline. _process_verified is mandatory path.

nodes.label: Sandbox
nodes.description: Attacker I/O isolation. Thread-safe (RLock). Command limits. Session management.

nodes.label: Session
nodes.description: Append-only crash-safe JSONL event log. fsync after each write. Session.wake() recovers from disk.

nodes.label: FictionConsistencyVerifier
nodes.description: 4 check layers: degenerate, danger_signals, identity_pin, fiction_contradictions. Optional: supported_claims (RAGIN_FAIL_CLOSED).

nodes.label: HostFictionVerifier
nodes.description: Wraps FictionConsistencyVerifier. Adds cross-session consistency check against HostFictionStore.

nodes.label: SupportedClaims
nodes.description: Fail-closed completeness on whoami/id/uname/hostname/echo/uptime/date/os-release. Opt-in via RAGIN_FAIL_CLOSED.

nodes.label: bridge_verifier_artifact
nodes.description: Canonical prompt-template artifact for supported commands (id, id -un, whoami) on the bridge path. Rewrites GENERATED_VERIFIED to PROMPT_TEMPLATE_VERIFIED.

nodes.label: HostFictionStore
nodes.description: Host-scoped fiction continuity. per_session policy default. Persists to data/host_fiction.json. mark_verified + promote_verified + atomic save.

nodes.label: FictionGraph
nodes.description: Session-scoped property graph of fabricated facts. declare/observe/fact_block. Stable predicates: os, kernel, hostname, domain, user, ip.

nodes.label: ChrolloAdapter
nodes.description: Wraps ChrolloClassifier to Classifier protocol. Builds SessionLog from context.

nodes.label: ChrolloClassifier
nodes.description: sklearn Random Forest (500 trees, max_depth=16). 0.8875 accuracy, Wilson CI [0.853, 0.914]. Needs joblib model + scaler.

nodes.label: DonAdapter
nodes.description: Wraps ThreatRAGEngine to CTIEngine protocol. Builds AnalysisRequest + session_log from context.

nodes.label: ThreatRAGEngine
nodes.description: Hybrid RAG: BM25 + vector (optional sentence-transformer) + optional LightRAG + optional LLM report. BM25 works offline.

nodes.label: HisokaAdapter
nodes.description: Wraps AdaptiveDeceiver to Deceiver protocol. Propagates serve_path labels, honeytoken_triggered, metadata.

nodes.label: AdaptiveDeceiver
nodes.description: Top-level deception orchestrator. Persona selection, scenario identity, canary arm, circuit breaker, cost tracker, engagement tracker.

nodes.label: ResponseGenerator
nodes.description: LLM draft via GatewayClient._gateway + deterministic fast-paths (sudo, IMDS, SSH, sudo -l, credential bait, FS replay) + post-processing (danger scrubbing, transcript styling).

nodes.label: GatewayClient
nodes.description: Shared HTTP client for LLM backends. Auth headers (Bearer + X-API-Key), WAF path rewrite, reasoning_effort=low, retry on empty content.

nodes.label: ProviderTransport
nodes.description: GatewayClient subclass. Fails closed (ProviderUnavailableError) when unauthenticated. Placeholder keys treated as unconfigured.

nodes.label: ProviderTransportAdapter
nodes.description: Injects ProviderTransport into ResponseGenerator._gateway. Routes to deterministic fallback on provider error.

nodes.label: ApprovalGateway
nodes.description: Risk-based policy: AUTO/NOTIFY/REQUIRE. ClaimedApprover (unattended), ConsoleApprover (interactive), FileAuditTrail (audit).

nodes.label: Jev System One
nodes.description: Free zen gateway (opencode.ai/zen/v1, key=public). Additive classification/orchestration signal. RAGIN_JEVI_ENABLED=1 default.

nodes.label: mTLS transport
nodes.description: build_server_context_from_env, peer_certificate_authorized. Optional via RAGIN_MTLS_REQUIRED. Tested (test_mtls_transport.py).

nodes.label: Cowrie SSH
nodes.description: SSH honeypot. Terminates attacker SSH. LLM backend POSTs to server_v2 /v1/chat/completions. Public attack surface.

nodes.label: NGINX
nodes.description: TLS termination, auth map (RAGIN_API_KEY → X-API-Key), routes to chrollo/don/hisoka/jev. Port 80/443/2222.

nodes.label: LLM Gateway (Rust)
nodes.description: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions. Upstream of OpenCode CLI bridge / OpenRouter / Azure. Port 8080.

nodes.label: OpenCode CLI Bridge
nodes.description: Loopback-only proxy. Local dev LLM backend. Config at scripts/opencode_cli_bridge_safe_config.json. Port 8731.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.description: Cache for RAGIN services. Port 6379. Appendonly yes, 256mb maxmemory.

nodes.label: Prometheus
nodes.description: Metrics collection. Port 9090. 30d retention.

nodes.label: Grafana
nodes.description: Dashboards. Port 3000. Admin password from env (default changeme in .env.example).

edges.description: Cowrie LLM backend POSTs full conversation history for each command
NGINX routes legacy component requests with auth
server_v2 routes all commands through Harness._process_verified

edges.path: check_supported_claim(user_input, text, ident) — only if RAGIN_FAIL_CLOSED
HostFictionVerifier.verify(response, ctx) — only if host_store installed and session passed
edges.description: Cross-session verification (only if inner verification passed)

edges.path: mark_verified + promote_verified + save — only on successful commit
edges.description: Persist verified facts to host fiction store

edges.path: graph.clone() + staged.observe(text) + graph.replace_from(staged) — only on successful commit
edges.description: Commit fiction graph update (with rollback on contradiction)

edges.path: _bridge_verifier_artifact(messages) — only on bridge path for supported commands
edges.description: Rewrite candidate to canonical template artifact for whoami/id/-un
RF model inference (needs joblib model + scaler)
CTI analysis: BM25 + vector + optional LLM report
LLM report generation (optional, degrades to heuristics when gateway unavailable)
HITL approval is part of the harness pipeline
Host fiction persistence is part of the commit path
Harness emits events to session log
mTLS is optional; server_v2 can use SSL context from env for TLS server
OpenCode bridge reaches external LLM provider (when configured)

local_docker_compose.description: Standard dev deployment. Runs legacy server.py services. server_v2 NOT a service.

field_deployment.description: Field deployment template. Requires approved private LLM bridge (placeholder in .env.field.example).

aws_historical.description: All AWS identifiers are historical. No current AWS state verified. No AWS access confirmed.

order: harness._strict_verify (HostFictionVerifier: cross-session check — only if inner passed and host_store installed)
harness._strict_commit (fiction graph clone + observe + contradictions check + bridge_verifier_artifact rewrite + host_fiction_store mark+promote+save)

fallback.trigger: max_retries+1 attempts exhausted without passing verification
fallback.action: ResponseGenerator._generate_template(skill, attacker_input, feedback, identity) → fallback_candidate → verify → approve → commit (FALLBACK_VERIFIED) or verified_serve_unavailable

serve_paths.GENERATED_VERIFIED: LLM draft that passed verification and approval
serve_paths.PROMPT_TEMPLATE_VERIFIED: Bridge verifier artifact (canonical whoami/id/-un template) — SSH wire proof
serve_paths.FALLBACK_VERIFIED: Deterministic template fallback after retry exhaustion
